events_detected.title: Japan confirms record $96.5B yen intervention — largest monthly on record
events_detected.description: Japan's Finance Ministry confirmed ¥15.39 trillion ($96.5B) spent July 30–Aug 26, largest monthly FX intervention on record. Single-day July 30 operation may have been ¥9.6T. BOJ meeting Aug 28 with 65% odds of rate hike. Yen near ¥159. Carry trade re-emerging per CNBC.
events_detected.source: Nikkei Asia, BNN Bloomberg, Business Times

events_detected.title: US Treasury actively capping bond yields — Bessent doubles buyback operations
events_detected.description: Treasury Secretary Bessent doubled liquidity-support buybacks from $2B to $4B per operation on Aug 19, explicitly targeting 10-30Y debt. US 10Y yield at 4.67%. Goldman Sachs expressing doubts about effectiveness. CNN reports analysts view it as attempt to drive down bond rates. Second intervention in weeks.
events_detected.source: CNN, Axios, Goldman Sachs via Yahoo Finance

events_detected.title: Strait of Hormuz — CENTCOM claims mines cleared, tanker attacked same day
events_detected.description: CENTCOM declared Hormuz cleared of Iranian sea mines (UPI Aug 28). However, allies skeptical mines fully cleared (Bloomberg/CNBC). Tanker attacked Aug 27 off Omani coast. Iran war Day 181 (6-month mark Aug 28). Qatar PM in Tehran for de-escalation talks. Iran/Oman proposing safe passage plan. Traffic still ~3/day vs 85 normal.
events_detected.source: UPI, CNBC, AP News, ABC News

events_detected.title: 2026 Ebola epidemic — 5,290 cases, 2,516 deaths, 2nd largest in history
events_detected.description: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC/Uganda. WHO PHEIC declared. Africa CDC estimates only 30-40% of infections detected — true cases could be 3x higher. Outpacing containment. MSF says communities still not receiving adequate support after 100 days.

events_detected.title: 5th US bank failure of 2026 — worst year since 2017

events_detected.source: American Banker, Credit and Collection News, Polymarket
